items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Zero-Day Remote Code Execution (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, codenamed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious PHP code into Magento's template system. It has a CVSS score of 10.0 and is actively being exploited in the wild to deploy backdoors and web shells.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
